prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1488; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the facts, but that's fine. It's the driver's name on my license, you have it already.
Q: I understand. For the record, can you confirm you were driving the vehicle at the time of the accident?
A: Yes, I was driving my own car.
Q: Where were you headed when it happened?
A: I was in Katy, Texas, turning left off the main road into a shopping center. It was a regular weekday.
Q: Walk me through what you saw before the turn.
A: I stopped at the light, waited for the oncoming lanes to clear, and then the light turned green for my direction. I started the turn when I thought it was safe.
Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle came through the intersection from the opposite direction and we collided on the front driver's side of my car. I didn't see it coming until right before impact.
Q: Did you or the other driver brake before contact?
A: I braked as soon as I saw the headlights, but there wasn't enough time to stop.
Q: Did you receive any medical attention after the collision?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same afternoon. They diagnosed a neck and back strain. I've been doing physical therapy since then.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes, my neck is stiff, especially when I turn my head to check traffic, and my lower back aches after sitting for long periods.
Q: Is there anything else you want to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I want this handled quickly so I can get back to work.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
